counterfactual_missing_items: No history of oral contraceptive or androgen use (male, no prior medical history)
No intratumoral fat or hemorrhage on imaging
decisive_items: three well-defined hypoechoic hepatic masses in segments 1 (67×53 mm), 6 (13 mm), and 2 (9 mm)
Hepatic arteriography demonstrated hypervascular masses in segments 1, 6, and 2 without pooling
lesion remained hypointense in the hepatobiliary phase
response.rationale: C1 best fits multiple hepatocellular adenomas: three well-defined hypervascular masses, high ADC, no FDG uptake, and hepatobiliary phase hypointensity. R2 hemangioma is less likely because arteriography shows no pooling and the lesion has an irregular margin with heterogeneous delayed enhancement rather than centripetal fill-in. R3 FNH is excluded by hepatobiliary phase hypointensity and absence of a central scar.

rejected.why: Correct diagnosis but incomplete; lacks the multiple distribution modifier.
Hemangioma less likely due to absent arteriographic pooling, irregular margin, and heterogeneous delayed enhancement rather than centripetal fill-in.
FNH excluded by hypointensity on hepatobiliary phase and absence of central scar.
